market.title: Tarik Skubal's Next Team
resolutionNote: Resolves to whichever team Tarik Skubal is officially on before Mar 25, 2027 - if he's still with Detroit or has retired by then, the 'Detroit Tigers' outcome resolves Yes instead.
Kalshi's own wording: "If Tarik Skubal's next team is Los Angeles D before Mar 25, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes."

Polymarket has a market on this too, but it asks a narrower question - whether a trade happens by the Aug 3, 2026 deadline specifically, defaulting to 'Detroit Tigers' if not. That's a different, nearer-term question from Kalshi's season-spanning contract, so it isn't paired here as a direct comparison - its live number is quoted in the Market Brief instead.

text: Tarik Skubal's fate was sealed when the Detroit Tigers blew a 7-0 lead in their game with the Baltimore Orioles on Wednesday, losing 10-9 in the end.
It left the Tigers, who have a 51-58 record this season, with no choice but to sell two-time Cy Young Award winner Skubal, with just days to find the best option before a deadline on Aug 3.
Skubal's most likely destination is the LA Dodgers, according to Kalshi, priced at around 50%, well above second-place option the Brewers (23%).
Notably, Skubal is a free agent after this season, so whoever does eventually trade for him will only get a two-month rental rather than a long-term answer.
Skubal has made it clear that he 'doesn't want to speculate' where he will end up, but whoever it is will need $9.6m to pay off the rest of his $32m contract.
marketBrief.author: Owain Flanders
